resources.string: Automation
New documents are organized in three steps, in this order. Each step only fills in what the steps before it left empty.
1. Rules
Your rules run first, as soon as a document’s text has been read. They are free and instant: when the text matches, they add tags and fill in fields.
No rules yet.
2. Auto-organize with the assistant
If auto-organize is on, the assistant then adds tags from the ones you already have and fills in fields that are still empty. Each new document costs one request to your AI provider.
On. This setting applies to this device only.
Off. This setting applies to this device only.
Off: the AI assistant is not turned on on this device.
AI assistant settings
3. Inbox
Whatever is still untagged waits in the Inbox for you. With the inbox workflow on, every new document waits there until you mark it reviewed.
The inbox workflow is on.
The inbox workflow is off: only untagged documents wait in the Inbox.
Inbox settings
When you ask
Suggestions for one document, and Bulk edit for many, run only when you start them, and change only what you accept.
Rules run from top to bottom. Every matching rule adds its tags; when two rules set the same field, the lower one wins. Rules only fill in what a document does not have yet.
Matches when the text contains the pattern exactly as typed, spaces and punctuation included. Capitals do not matter.
Matches when the text contains at least one of the pattern’s words as a whole word. Capitals do not matter.
Matches when the text contains every word of the pattern as a whole word, in any order. Capitals do not matter.
Matches a regular expression, for patterns such as invoice or customer numbers. Capitals do not matter.
Matches text that is close to the pattern, so scanning errors and small typos still match.
Type a pattern to see which documents it matches.
